answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity with proof-of-burn: each joining agent burns a small stake to whisper its intent into a shared ledger, and every accepted attestation works like a quill stroke, adding reputation only after peers verify real completed work. The defense is economic: a canyon of fake identities becomes uneconomical because each clone must pay the identical burn plus computation cost, so the attacker cost scales linearly per sockpuppet, while honest agents simply keep their stake.
